card.name: Section number 12 in cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit after the opening "1" in a section number inside a bracketed cross-reference, mostly the "2" of 12.x after "Clinical Pharmacology (". It also fires on the "4" of 14 after "Clinical Studies (".

modes.label: Clinical Pharmacology 12.x
modes.description: The "2" completing section 12 in a reference to Clinical Pharmacology.

modes.label: Clinical Studies 14.x
modes.description: The "4" completing section 14 in a reference to Clinical Studies.

card.plain: It marks the second digit of a two-digit section number, such as 12.3, in the bracketed "see Clinical Pharmacology" cross-references of a drug label.
